    from scipy.optimize import least_squares
    print("scipy ok")
except Exception as ex:
    print("noscipy",ex)
def run(name,f,n,starts=40):
    rng=np.random.default_rng(0); best=(1e9,None)
    for s in range(starts):
        p0=rng.normal(0,1,n)
        try:
            r=least_squares(lambda p: f(p)-sigma,p0,max_nfev=1000)
            val=np.mean(r.fun**2)/v
            if np.isfinite(val) and val<best[0]: best=(val,r.x)
        except Exception as ex:
            pass
    print(name, best[0], np.round(best[1],4) if best[1] is not None else None)
